description: This file contains implementation of PyTorch's JIT tracing functionalities, including functions for tracing modules and functions, verification, and internal utilities for TorchScript compilation.

classes.name: ONNXTracedModule
classes.description: A custom torch.nn.Module that wraps an inner module or callable for tracing with additional features like returning inputs and states.

classes.name: TracedModule
classes.description: A ScriptModule subclass representing a traced version of a torch.nn.Module, supporting attribute forwarding and reconstruction.

classes.name: TopLevelTracedModule
classes.description: A subclass of TracedModule with cached forward and reconstruction capabilities.

classes.name: TracingCheckError
classes.description: Custom exception for errors during trace sanity checks, including graph and tensor comparison errors.

classes.name: TracerWarning
classes.description: Custom warning class for tracer-related warnings, with methods to ignore library warnings.

methods.name: _create_interpreter_name_lookup_fn
methods.description: Creates a function to look up variable names in the current frame's local variables.

methods.name: _unique_state_dict
methods.description: Returns a deduplicated state dictionary of a module, optionally keeping variables.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies that a JIT-compiled model produces the same outputs and gradients as the uncompiled version.

methods.name: _verify_equal
methods.description: Checks if two lists of tensors are approximately equal.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Indents a string with tabs for formatting.

methods.name: _check_trace
methods.description: Checks the consistency of a traced module or function against a set of inputs, including graph and tensor comparisons.

methods.name: make_tuple
methods.description: Wraps example inputs into a tuple if they are not already.

methods.name: make_module
methods.description: Creates a ScriptModule from a given module, possibly using tracing or scripting.

methods.name: wrap_check_inputs
methods.description: Wraps check inputs into a list of dicts with 'forward' key.

methods.name: analyze_ts_result_with_export_result
methods.description: Compares exported and traced results for consistency.

methods.name: _trace_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for tracing a function or module, handling various cases and checks.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Public API to trace a function or module into a TorchScript object with optional verification.

methods.name: trace_module
methods.description: Traces a module's methods into a TorchScript module with verification.

methods.name: is_tracing
methods.description: Returns True if currently in tracing mode, False otherwise.

methods.name: _script_if_tracing
methods.description: Decorator that scripts a function if in tracing mode.

methods.name: _get_trace_graph
methods.description: Returns a trace graph for a function or module, used internally.
